No reading until the frame moves, as Crop again does (v244). **The label is `t("Crop")`, not a new word** — it is the same view, so it gets the app's own name for it and needs no key in any column. **One key was needed and it is a correctness fix, not decoration:** `showCropPreview`'s `noRead` badge says "The frame the card was cut with — adjust it to read again.", which is **false here** — no card has been cut — so the preview takes "The frame the app found — adjust it, then read." when `opts.found`; the Edit form's sentence is untouched. The guide's Crop paragraph carries the new clause in all ten columns (the v259 rule), rewritten per column rather than key-swapped, since replacing an English key without its nine translations would have dropped that whole paragraph to English everywhere. 448 keys a column → **449**, ru 477 → **478**, no duplicate in any column (source scan and evaluation agree). **Measured end to end** (`verify-autoedit`, the synthetic poster): the row offers Crop and Cancel with **no layer drawn** during the scan; the tap leaves `AUTO` and `PENDING` off with **0 empty placeholders**, the frame standing with its five handles including the turn handle, the frame **equal to the app's own to within 2 %** (0.4–99.6 % across, 24.4–91.1 % down), **no reading started**, the new badge, the photo still in the inbox; a corner dragged 14 × 10 px then reads and Save card stores 手作冰淇淋 **with the hand's frame**; and with two photos from the album the second stays in `AUTOQ` with nothing reading while the frame stands. Suites: `verify-guide`, `verify-savenow` and `verify-english` ALL OK; `verify-autocard` times out on `.card .glyph` at its line 84 **byte-identically on a v436 baseline root built by copying the tree**, so it is the flake v417 first recorded and not this change (its `verify-batch` was written in an earlier session and is not in this scratchpad — the v411 queue invariant is covered by `verify-autoedit`'s own fourth case instead). **What the suite does not really test:** its German check reads the row after the save, and the label comes from the same `t("Crop")` key the ordinary button uses — the shared key is what makes it safe, not the assertion. **No `WHATS_NEW` line was skipped:** a new button on the camera screen is exactly what the v408 rule means by something a learner notices. **Open, and it is H's original word:** he wrote *Drehen*, and the question whether he means the frame's turn handle (this is what he gets) or turning the **photo itself** by 90° for a shot taken sideways (the app cannot do that at all, and nothing here changes it) was asked and not answered — he replied "Go", so the frame reading is what was built.

**The AI is asked again with the whole photo when its answer sits in a corner of the picture (v393, H's rice cooker taken again at v392: two cards, 时 and 分, where the panel carries eleven labels — "Why only those 2?"):** his diagnostics named the cause. The ink rows had proposed **27–77 % down** of a washed-out white panel, where the strongest ink is the display's black rectangle and the buttons' dashes and not the faint grey labels; measured against his own photo, the top label row stands at **22–25 %** and the bottom row at **79–82 %**, so both were cut away before the AI ever saw them. What went to Qwen held the dashes, the display and 时 / 分 — and its answer, "labels on a digital clock or timer display panel", was right about that picture. **The app cannot judge its own proposal beforehand:** sending the whole photo on every weak reading was built first and reverted unmerged, because the aiframe suite showed it moving cards H has already confirmed — the near 邪不压正 lost its straightening (the whole-photo cut has no deskew), the vending machine's frame grew to 17–97 % across and the ice-cream poster's to 9–97 % down. Afterwards it can: when the answer's box covers under `PIC_SMALL` 0.15 of the picture, is smaller than `PIC_SIDE` 0.35 of its width and 0.6 of its height, and lies within `PIC_EDGE` 0.05 of one of its edges, the text the model found is at the border of what the app chose and there is very likely more beyond it — the frame then reaches the whole photo and the AI reads once more, through the path a `bad` answer already takes (v348), and its second box places, snaps and centres as any answer's does. **Small in both directions, not only in area:** a box spanning much of one dimension is a line of text running along that edge, and v313's grow past that edge is its answer — H's 北京现代 badge answers with a box 37 % of the picture's width along its top, and a first cut without the side test took it into the re-ask, where the frame came to depend on the snap of a second box and came out worse. Diagnostics: "the AI found the text in 2 % of the picture, against its edge — the frame reaches the whole photo (0–100 % across, 0–100 % down) and the AI reads again". What it costs: one more Qwen call on such a photo. Measured on H's rice cooker rebuilt from his screenshot with **Qwen's own answer from his AI log** (box `[730,140,780,310]` of 800×450, 2 % of the picture against its right edge): **11 cards** — 低卡饭, 柴火饭, 快煮, 粗粮饭, 汤/粥, 时, 分, 保温取消, 预约, 开始, 功能 — where the app made 2, in two calls; the aiframe, picture, badpic, english and panel suites pass unchanged, and `verify-autoframe`'s `read` case fails as it has since v356 (a pre-existing flake of the reader on H's poster). **Field-checked 2026-09-10 at v393** (H's rice cooker taken again: **11 cards**, the whole panel read — and six of them showing the same wide slab of the panel, two or three buttons in each picture). **Nothing else may stand in a free-standing element (v394):** the rule of v392 found an element wherever a label had room around it in its own answer row and handed that room to every label inside it, so 低卡饭, 柴火饭, 快煮, 粗粮饭, 汤/粥 and 保温取消 all got one rectangle of 37–68 % across, 41–74 % down. An element is free-standing only when **no other label the reader placed stands in it**: the washer's dial holds 下筒 alone, while every gap on the rice cooker's panel holds two or three of its own buttons, so no region is made there at all and each label keeps its own run's cut. And the region is the picture of the label that established it and of the words on the element the reader could not place at all (the dial's 左筒 and 右筒 would share it) — **a placed label never joins another's region**. Measured on H's rice cooker rebuilt from his screenshot with an eleven-label drawn grid: the five labels the reader placed get their own tight crops (时 62–68 %, 分 79–82 %, 预约 38–47 %, 开始 58–66 %, 功能 77–86 %) where six had shared one slab; on H's washing machine the dial's card is unchanged — the ring with 左筒, 右筒, 下筒 and the clock —, 20 cards, 18 on their own label, none on a neighbour's. Not yet field-checked — H's rice cooker taken again is the check: a card per button, each showing its own button. **Each label's frame comes from the pixels, not from the model's box (v359, H's rice cooker taken again at v358 — the four top cards showed the small black button instead of its label: "Cropped wrong areas"):** the photo was rebuilt exactly (1600×1429, the proposal 0–71 % across, the picture the AI saw 637×800, Qwen's real answer from the diagnostics) and the harness reproduced the phone's frames to the percent — and drawing the answer's own boxes on that picture said why: **Qwen's per-label boxes sit on the buttons**, one label height below the characters ([158,236,255,285] for 低卡饭, whose text stands at y 189–216), and `snapBox` then did its job on the ink it was pointed at. The union box drifted the same way and the v326 band check caught that one ("a line above the AI's box, read as 快毒粗粮饭"); the label boxes had nothing to catch theirs. So **a label's box is an anchor, not a measurement**: `labelRect(bmp,box,uni)` looks around it — `LB_UP` 1.6 box heights above and below, `LB_SIDE` 1.5 sideways — for the row of ink the label stands in. Ink rows give the bands (`LB_ROW` 2 % of the region's width), a band of the anchor's own order of height (`LB_MINH` 0.2 to `LB_MAXH` 1.25 of it) is a candidate, its columns are cut into runs at gaps of `LB_MERGE` half a band height — inside a label the characters nearly touch, between two labels there is a character's width of air — and each run is scored: **twice its overlap with the anchor, less how far its centre sits from the anchor's, less how much its width differs from the anchor's** — the model's box may sit on the button but its *width* is the label's, and the button is a third of that — with the nearest row counting only as a tiebreaker (`LB_NEAR` 0.6, since the boxes drift by a whole label height). A run that fills `LB_FILL` 0.8 of its box is solid — a button, a bar, a plate — and is not characters (measured: 低卡饭 fills 0.45 of its box, the button under it 0.89). A second row joins when it sits within `LB_GAP` of the first and stands over it (保温 above 取消). **The cut** comes from the label's own surroundings when they hold ink (`LB_INK0` 0.5 % to `LB_INK1` 35 % of the region, the minority class) — a panel is lit unevenly and one cut over the whole answer's box lost the characters at its dim end (粗粮饭 came out as 粗粮) —, else from the whole answer's box, which certainly holds ink: over surroundings that are bare panel Otsu splits the panel's own gradient in half and the characters drown in it (预约, whose anchor stands on bare panel). Nothing of the kind near the anchor: the AI's box stays as it is, and Diagnostics says so per label ("低卡饭: the AI's box 25–40 % across, 30–36 % down, its characters at 27–41 %, 24–27 %"). `snapBox` is not used in the split path at all — its room reaches into the neighbours and its poster passes take the button. Measured on the rebuilt photo: all seven labels whole in their own card picture, where v358 gave four buttons, a half label and a miss. **A panel with two dozen buttons (v360, H's washing machine at v359 — 24 labels and not one card: "Die Waschmaschine hat allerdings nicht funktioniert"; Diagnostics `[picture] could not read the model's answer` and a reply that stops inside its `boxes` array):** the picture call asked for `max_tokens` **1000** (v173's number, for one sign's short JSON), and Qwen's answer for 26 elements — every one with its own pinyin, meaning and rectangle — ran past it and was cut off mid-JSON, so `JSON.parse` threw, the reading fell back to the reader's garbage 引事组, DeepSeek called it garbage and the phone kept one flagged card. Four things now. **(1) The budget** is `PIC_TOKENS` 4000 (the text check's own), and the prompt asks the model to leave `"boxes"` out when it gives `"labels"`, whose entries carry their own rectangles — that halves the answer of a panel. **(2) The picture gets its own timeout** (`PIC_TIMEOUT_MS` 60 s beside `AI_TIMEOUT_MS` 25 s, `timedFetch`/`aiFetch`/`relayFetch` take it as an argument): the cut-off answer already took 22 s, so a whole one would have been aborted by the v331 rule and thrown away twice. **(3) An answer that stops in the middle keeps what came** (`mendJSON`): the text is cut back to the last comma or bracket, every open bracket is closed and the fields that arrived whole are used — the card then has the text even when the boxes or the labels never did, and Diagnostics says "the AI's answer stopped in the middle — kept what came (zh, p, m, note, box)". **(4) A label whose frame cannot be cut no longer refuses the split**: the placeable ones keep their cards and the log names the rest ("no frame for 长按童锁, 长按单烘 … — the other labels keep their cards"), `SPLIT_PX` is 8 copy pixels (16 until v359) — a panel's fine print stands 6 px tall in the 800 px picture. And **the labels are measured on the frame at its own pixels** (`labelGrey(bmp,uni)` prepares the grey, the threshold and the ink's polarity once for the whole panel, up to `LB_CAP` 1600, and `labelRect(gy,box)` works in fractions on it): until v359 every label rebuilt the whole picture as a canvas — 24 of them — at the 800 px the AI saw, where a washing machine's label is 16 pixels tall. Measured on H's photo rebuilt with its 24 labels (the texts and meanings from Qwen's own answer, the boxes drifted onto the icons as the model drifts): **20 cards, each with its own text, pinyin and meaning**, where v359 made none; the four lines of fine print are left out for want of a frame. **A label's card picture is its own cut at the photo's pixels (v362, H: "Now do the label crops at full resolution"):** until v361 `splitCards` took the 16:9 window of v329 (`windowCut`), which is right for a sign that fills its photo and wrong for a button — a label of about 80 × 36 photo pixels widened to 16:9 carries its neighbours into the picture, and on H's washing machine nearly every card showed two or three buttons. Now the picture is `cropBlob(id, the label's own frame)` — the frame the label was placed on, cut from the photo at its own pixels, no widening; the front's 16:9 box shows it with the blurred fill of v232 beside it, as a tall crop has always been shown. Nothing else changes: the card's `frame` is the same, Crop again starts where it did, a photo that makes one card keeps the 16:9 window. Measured on H's washing machine rebuilt with its 24 labels: **fifteen of the twenty cards show their own label and nothing else** (混合 快速 单脱水 煮洗 羽绒 大件 羊毛 智洗烘 袜子 云程序 内裤 时间 漂洗 温度 +烘干), where every card carried its neighbours before; the rice cooker's seven cards are tight on their labels too. **What is still wrong there:** 洗衣液 and 柔顺剂 take the row above them (云程序 stands right over 洗衣液, and the two-line rule of v359 cannot tell that from 保温 above 取消), 筒自洁 and 血渍洗 take a fragment of the row above, and 下筒 inside the dial finds no characters and keeps the AI's box. Tried and dropped on the way, both unmerged: cutting the chosen band back to the label's own rows inside the run's columns (the anchor sits on the icon, so the nearest block is the icon's, and 快速, 单脱水, 煮洗 and 智洗烘 lost their characters), and refusing the two-line join when both rows do not fit the anchor's own height (the take is the icon's row on this panel and the label joins as its "second line" — with the guard four good cards became the icon alone). What that says: **on this panel the run the app takes is the icon's, and the label rides along** — the width match cannot separate an outline icon from two characters of the same width. The next step, when H asks, is a test for what is text and what is a drawing. Measured in the harness on H's own photos with the model's answers mocked: the rice cooker 11 cards with every frame on its own label, the washing machine 23, the dishwasher's lower panel 2, the oven's two columns 6, **three texts one under the other 3** — a panel's column, a wall of separate signs, the case v357's geometry refused; an answer without labels, one whose boxes are not all on the same scale, one whose box covers the whole picture and `apart:false` each make exactly one card. Suite `verify-panel` (all of those, **the phone's own case — the rice cooker photo with Qwen's real answer, the reader stood down as it was on the phone: seven cards, each frame covering its own label** —, the row's head and buttons, Edit opening that label's card from the camera, Delete with Undo, the German head line); the aiframe (32 cases), autocard, picture, badpic, savenow, english, guide, cards, detail, recrop, recropai, edit, ask, pick and twopass suites pass; checked by screenshot in light, dark and German. What it costs: no extra AI call, about a second more before the row fills, and a panel's worth of cards in the deck at once (Learn still gives eight new a session). Not yet field-checked — H's rice cooker taken again is the check: a card per button, each showing its own label. (`verify-autoframe`'s `read` case fails on v356 too — a pre-existing flake of the reader on H's poster, not this change.) The lead line reads "Photos stay on this phone. Take one — the card is made for you." and the guide's first section describes the new flow (Crop and Save now in its second paragraph), both in six languages. **The harness:** `S.autoCard` (from `window.AUTO_CARD`, which the seed sets to false) keeps the crop-mode flow for the frame suites — the hidden proposal, the shown frame, the preview; the autocard suite switches it on after boot. Measured in the harness on the synthetic poster: the finished card at 4.3 s with the frame 8–91 % across, 66–84 % down (the quick look's), one AI call, unflagged. Suite `verify-autocard` (the shimmer, the bar and Cancel with no layer and no Save now; the result with the front, the back and the buttons, the card verified with the placed frame and its cut to the pixel, the photo tap both ways; Edit opening the form with the frame at the card's frame and no reading, Back to the result; Delete with Undo and the photo kept; Cancel dropping the placeholder with nothing left running; a blank image making no card, with the note; 邪不压正 with a bad AI verdict flagged with the note; a reload while reading resuming to the result; the German lead and buttons); checked by screenshot in light, dark and German; the autoframe, aiframe, savenow, picture, recrop, english and guide suites pass. Not yet field-checked — the next photo on the Xiaomi is the check: no frame, the light over the photo, the finished card with Edit and Delete under it.
2. **Frame (Crop, Crop again, and the harness's crop-mode flow):** the photo lands directly in crop mode. **A photo that opens by itself gets its frame drawn by the app** (v203, H's poster photo that needed no framing: "do an automatic image analysis and suggest a crop, which the user can change if needed — or apply no crop at all", described first and built on "Go"): while the reading box says "Finding the text …" with the bar, `textRegion` takes the ink of a 360 px chromaticity copy, the rows that look like text (the inkHeight rule with four stroke edges), the first and last of them, the columns holding ink inside that band, padded by one text height — and proposes **the whole photo** when nothing stands out or the text fills it (H's "no crop at all"); **the proposed frame has a fixed shape whenever the photo allows it** (v207, H: "propose a certain aspect ratio that fits for most images — I want uniformity across image previews", described first with 16:9 recommended, built on "Go"): `shapeBox` widens the padded text box, never narrows it, to `FRAME_RATIO` 16:9 — the shape of the Cards list's 124×70 thumbnails —, centred on the text and shifted to stay inside the photo; a text the photo cannot hold at that shape (a tall sign, a text that fills the photo) keeps its own padded box or the whole photo, so those previews stay irregular; the card image then carries more surroundings, the reader's second look tightens as before, frames drawn by hand are untouched; `proposeFrame` sets `CROP.rect` from the layer's size (`CROP.proposed` = "whole" / "16:9" / "text", a line in Diagnostics' reading steps that says which), draws the frame and hands over to `showCropPreview`, so the usual wait and the reading follow without a finger; a finger, Cancel or another photo during the ~100 ms drops the proposal. The proposed frame is adjustable like a drawn one (corners, moving, the handle). It comes only with a photo that opens by itself — taken, the first from the album, shared (`CROP.auto` set in `importPhotos`); **the Crop button never proposes**, so Cancel, then Crop, gives the empty layer to draw on as before. **How the frame is found today (v287–v312, consolidated on H's "Zieh CLAUDE.md nach" at v312):** the ink-row proposal is computed as before but **never drawn in the inbox** (`CROP.hidden`; `proposeFrame` logs "frame proposed by the app (not shown): …") — drawings and Latin letters extend it, and H wants the frame shown once, on the text (v287–v288, his poster 手作冰淇淋 under a wide proposed frame: "Why don't you automatically crop the chinese text?", then on a frame that moved after the reading: "Only show the frame after identifying the right area, don't make an existing frame jump. Notify the user that the frame is being analyzed while searching for the text. And of course, the analysis must be super fast"). The photo opens with the bar "Finding the text …", no frame, no handles, no Save now, no preview, no 1.2 s wait — `cropSign` starts at once from `proposeFrame`. Then, in this order: **(1) The quick look** (v290, H: "Why does it take so long? you don't need to translate first, you just need to identify text first"): while the frame is hidden, one pass on a copy of at most `FIRST_MAX` 1 000 px (status "looking for the text …"; 0.3 s on H's poster in the sandbox against 1.1 s for the whole 1 600 px frame); its confident boxes (`frameBoxes`: `SURE_BOX` 70, a lone character beside a line of three or more left out — the score's fragment rule, the ice-cream cone read as 槛 / 及 / 环 at 88 % by every colour pass, while 喜欢 and 爸爸 with two characters stay) give the lines, `textRowExtent` their ends from the image, and `frameOnText` places the frame there with `FRAME_ROOM` 0.3 text heights around the text and **no 16:9 widening** (v293, H on the ALEXA 35 card whose 16:9 frame held a logo and a field of fabric with 再创标杆 small in the middle: "Make the automatic crop frame tighter. Chinese Text should be well readable in the thumbnail list" — the Cards list's box is 16:9 itself with the blurred fill behind, and a one-line text widened to 16:9 came out at half the thumbnail's width; the ink-row proposal keeps its 16:9 of v207 as the fallback). **Garbage places nothing** (`textLike(lines)`, v296 — H's 邪不压正 poster: the faces read as 品语失色全了 at 86 % were framed tightly and sent to Qwen, "Oh no! jetzt macht er gesichtserkennung!?!??": half the characters in dictionary words of two or more, or the confident characters read at 95 % on average — **since v319 at least three characters read with confidence, at 95 % on average, and no dictionary path; since v320 fine print under 0.4 of the frame's ink height places nothing; since v321 the reading's winning whole-frame pass places the frame when nothing else did**, see below; Diagnostics "quick look: … — not text, no frame from it"; the price: a lone character the reader misreads at the quick look, the red test's 有 read as 角 at 85 %, keeps the ink-row proposal); a band that is the frame itself shows the proposal at once ("frame shown as proposed — the text fills it"). The quick look is not one of the reading's passes (tried as the first pass it lost 爸爸 on H's poster), so the reading — the native first pass, the close look, the fallbacks — runs unchanged after it. `textLike` is a function declaration since v305, so the harness can stand it down as it does `effScore` (the overrides are restored, never deleted — a declaration's global binding cannot be deleted). **(2) The close look's placement** as the fallback for a quick look without a usable box: `secondLook` calls `r.onTight(textArea)` after its colour passes, and `place` in `cropSign` runs again after the whole close look — `textBandOf(tightPasses,cardRect)`: per pass the extent of its confident boxes, the quartiles over the passes (a stray one-pass read is out, a line most passes saw is in, a lone pass counts as it is), half a text height of room at the ends since the boxes' ends drift (v69), never outside the second look's band, turned back into the frame as framed (`unrotatedBox`, shared with `cutUnrotated`); only the simplified reader's tight passes as read, and only those that pass `textLike`. **(3) The 2 s fallback** (`FRAME_WAIT`, v289, H: "Show the ink-row frame after 2 seconds if the reader is slower"): a timer in `proposeFrame` drops `CROP.hidden` and draws the proposal as the frame (Diagnostics "frame shown as proposed — the reader took longer than 2 s"; the card image then takes the second look's band, `cutUnrotated`, when nothing is placed). **The shown proposal may still move once** (v310, H's 风流一代 poster: the reading proper on the whole photo stood at "recognizing … 46 %" at the 2 s mark, the close look then read the title at 97 % on four passes, and the frame stayed the whole photo with the first pass's garbage band as the card's picture — "Warum wurde hier nichts cropped?"; two ways offered, H: "Do A"): `place` and `frameOnText`'s guard allow the reader's placement while `CROP.proposed` stands and nothing was placed yet (`!CROP.followed`) — the one jump H rejected in v288, only in the slow case, only from the app's proposal, never after a finger touched it. Option B, the frame staying while only the card's picture is cut on the text, was not built. **(4) The AI's box** when the reading is weak (`WEAK_READ` by `effScore`) or the text check calls it garbage (`picOnBad`, v302): `picSystem()` asks for `"box":[left,top,right,bottom]` — one rectangle around all the lines read, **in pixels of the picture, whose size the user message names** ("… this picture (800×544 pixels)"; v294 — v293 asked for fractions and Qwen's answer came a tenth off; whether pixels land better is not settled, the three real answers on 邪不压正 were each a tenth or two too far right) and, since v312, `"boxes"`, one rectangle per line of zh in the same order; `picBox` returns fractions (pixels of the sent picture and a 0–1000 grid are scaled, fractions accepted; a box under 2 % or malformed is none; `r.pic.box` in Diagnostics). While the frame is still the app's (`CROP.proposed` — the hidden proposal, the shown one, or a frame the quick look placed; `READ_APP[id]` for a card saved with Save now; never one the hand touched), the box is mapped onto the picture the AI saw (`picSeen`) and `frameOnText(…,"AI")` places the frame there, once ("frame placed on the text by the AI: …"). **The picture the AI gets** (`picBase`, `sg.picBlob` for the garbage-verdict path): **since v319 always the area the reading started from with its straightening** (`r.blob`, `dk`; Diagnostics "the AI gets the whole proposal, not the placed frame's cut" when a frame was placed), see the v319 paragraph below; **from v301 to v318** the placed frame's cut when the frame stood on text the reader could read (`CROP.followed` or `PLACED[id]`, upright already — v301, H's 绿皮书 poster: the quick look had placed the frame on the title block, the reading proper on the whole proposal was weak, the whole poster went to Qwen and the card came back with the Oscar nominations from the top edge: "warum wurden hier characters ausserhalb des crops mitgelesen?"; Diagnostics "the AI gets the placed frame's cut"), else the area the reading started from with its straightening (`r.blob`, `dk`) — never a placed cut from garbage (v296; v288–v295 had sent the placed cut). On the placed cut the box **centres the frame inside the placed one** (v303, H's 绿皮书 card: "Works now, but should be more centered. I like the fact that you cropped around the large main characters. Was that coincidence or not?" — no coincidence, the quick look read 绿友书一 at 97 %; the 一 was a reflection streak through the hook of 书, so `textRowExtent` walked along it to the photo's right edge; `refine` in `frameOnText`, `seenBase` = the placed frame: the box's rectangle in the upright cut is turned with the frame around the frame's centre and laid inside it, the frame moves once more, only inward; "frame centred on the text by the AI: …"). **The box is snapped to the characters** first (`snapBox`, below). **The main text only** (v312, H's 青春无烟 / 未来无限 poster: the small line 第39个世界无烟日 above the title and the date line below it, half of it outside the frame, on the card — Qwen had read them from the whole proposal before its box placed the frame: "Hier hat er wieder die Sachen ausserhalb des Crops und das Kleingedruckte mitgelesen. Bitte beides vermeiden"): the prompt asks for the main text and leaves fine print — lines whose characters are under a third the height of the largest (dates, credits, small notes, slogans in small type) — and any line the picture's edge cuts off to the model; `mainLines` in `aiReadPicture` is the safety net from the line boxes: a line under `FINE_PRINT` (a third) of the tallest line's height is dropped with its pinyin and meaning parts when they come one per line (" / "), the box becomes the union of the lines kept, so the frame no longer stretches to the small print; Diagnostics "fine print left out of the AI's answer: …", `r.pic.boxes`/`dropped`. What it costs: a poster's credits smaller than a third of its title leave the card (the v300 per-line meanings stay for lines of comparable size). **A box on the edge of the app's proposal reaches beyond it** (v313, H's 北京现代 badge on a car, 2026-09-07: the ink rows had cut the chrome characters in half at the proposal's top — 32–78 % down —, the quick look and the reading read garbage, Qwen read 北京现代 from the visible halves and boxed them at y 0–55 of the 496 px picture, the snap found nothing at that size, and the frame at 32–39 % down showed half characters: "Why is the crop so wrong here?"): when the picture the AI saw is the app's proposal with its straightening (`picSeen.dk`) and the box touches the picture's top, bottom, left or right edge within 2 %, the text may go on beyond it — `frameOnText` takes `grow`, room in the copy's pixels beyond that edge (1.5 box heights above or below, two box heights sideways), extends the frame past the proposal's edge into the photo and clips it to the photo (upright frames only); Diagnostics "the AI's box touches the picture's top edge — the frame reaches beyond it". Nothing for the hand's frame or the whole photo, where there is nothing beyond. Measured on the red 有 with a mocked box at the proposal's top edge: the frame from 26 % down where the proposal began at 36 %. What it cannot do: know how much of the text lies beyond — a line cut lower than half its height gets less than it needs, and the ink-row proposal that cut it is untouched (the badge's chrome reflects the sky, so its upper halves left no ink rows). Suite `verify-aiframe` (the red 有 with the box on the top edge: the frame above the proposal's top, the log line); the autoframe and english suites pass. Not yet field-checked — the badge taken again is the check: the whole characters in the card's picture. **A line the app's frame cut off is read again (v314, H's 大闸蟹 / 我选蟹状元 poster, 2026-09-07: the close look had placed the frame at 37–77 % down, through the first line; the AI got that cut, read 我选蟹状元 alone with the note "The top line is cut off by the image edge and omitted" — the v312 rule at work —, and the card had the second line only: "Warum nur die zweite zeile und nicht auch die erste???"):** `picSystem()` asks for `"cut"` — the edges of the picture that cut off a line of Chinese text the model left out because of that ("top", "bottom", "left", "right", several separated by commas, "" when none); `aiReadPicture` hands it back as `cut`. In `cropSign`, when the first picture answer is good and names a cut edge and the frame is still the app's (`CROP.proposed`, or `READ_APP[id]` for a Save-now card) and not turned, the standing frame (`CROP.rect`, or `PLACED[id]`; since v319 the frame the AI saw, `base` — the proposal —, whatever the reader placed meanwhile) grows past every named edge — by 1.2 × the tallest line's height until v317, to the photo's edge since v318, see below —; the new frame becomes the placed one (`CROP.followed`, `PLACED[id]`), its cut the picture (`placedCut`, `picBase` with no straightening) and **the AI reads once more** from it — Diagnostics "the AI says the picture's top edge cuts off a line — the frame reaches beyond it (8–91 % across, 58–85 % down) and the AI reads again"; the second answer then places, snaps and centres as any answer does (`r.pic.cut`). Once per reading; a second answer naming a cut edge changes nothing. What it costs: one more Qwen call in that case. Nothing for the hand's frame, a turned frame or a frame that is the whole photo. Measured on the synthetic poster with a mocked Qwen that first names the top edge: the placed frame 65–85 % down grows to 58–85 %, the second call gets a taller picture (252 → 342 px) and answers both lines, the frame is centred at 68–82 % with 喜欢 and 手作冰淇淋 on the card. Suite `verify-aiframe` (the cut line: two calls with the second picture taller, both lines, the grown frame's log line and the centred one); the picture, badpic and english suites pass. Not yet field-checked — the 大闸蟹 poster taken again is the check: both lines on the card. **A frame that holds no Chinese text at all is opened to the whole photo, and no card is made from garbage (v348, H's scooter badge 九号 Fz110, 2026-09-08 — the card read 量词口还 under a picture of the yellow Fz110 plate: "Und noch ein knaller: voll falsch!"):** the ink rows proposed 47–93 % across, 45–64 % down — the yellow plate beside the white characters, the strongest ink in the photo —, the quick look read 看户11吕 at 80 % and placed nothing, every pass came back garbage, and Qwen, given that cut, answered `bad` with "The image shows a label with Latin letters and numbers ('Fz 110') but no Chinese characters" — right about the picture it was shown; DeepSeek called the reading garbage too, and the card was made from it all the same. Two things now. **(1) The frame reaches the whole photo and the AI reads again:** when the picture answer is `bad` and the frame is the app's own (the proposal, or `READ_APP[id]` for a card saved with Save now) and not turned, the frame grows past every edge — the v314/v318 path with all four sides named — and the AI reads the whole photo once more, its box then placing, snapping and centring as any answer's does; Diagnostics "the AI found no Chinese text in the picture — the frame reaches the whole photo (0–100 % across, 0–100 % down) and the AI reads again". Once per reading, never for the hand's frame or a turned one, nothing when the frame is the photo already. **(2) A card the app makes by itself is not made when the AI found no Chinese text in the picture** (`sg.noText`, set wherever a picture answer comes back bad — the weak path and `picOnBad`): `finishPending` hands such a reading to `failPending`, the placeholder goes and the photo keeps its Crop with "Nothing could be read. Tap Crop to frame the text by hand." — the v325 rule for a photo with nothing readable. A text check that calls the reading garbage stays weaker evidence, since it never saw the picture, and still makes a flagged card as in v325 (H's 邪不压正 poster on a phone without a picture provider). What it costs: one more Qwen call on a photo whose framed area holds no Chinese; a photo that really has none now leaves no card where it left a flagged one. Measured in the harness on the badge rebuilt from H's screenshot (the proposal on the plate, the answer bad, then good on the whole photo): two calls, 563×334 then 800×784, the box on 九号 snapped 12–50 % across, 43–57 % down, the frame 8–54 % across, 39–61 % down; with both answers bad the row says so and no card is made. Suite `verify-aiframe` (`nine`), suite `verify-autocard` (`noText`, and the weak case — a garbage reading without a picture provider — still makes its flagged card); the picture, badpic, savenow and english suites pass. Not yet field-checked — the badge taken again is the check: 九号 on the card, or no card at all. What it cannot do: make the ink rows see the white characters beside the plate — the frame is opened only after the AI has said there is nothing in it.

**The snap** (`snapBox(bmp,box,n,lens)`, v297, H's 邪不压正 poster: Qwen's box `[230,190,740,510]` of 800×647 a tenth too far right — it cut 邪 between 牙 and 阝 — and a tenth too low into the faces under HIDDEN MAN: "Schrift ist immer noch nicht mittig im Rahmen und links leicht abgeschnitten. Insbesondere unten zu viel Luft."; a vision model's box is a rough place, the pixels know the characters): on a grey copy of at most 800 px, thresholded by Otsu over the box, the connected blobs of both colours are labelled within the box widened by one text height (`SNAP_ROOM`; the text height = the box's height over the answer's lines), each colour as it is and eroded by up to 3 px (`Hb/60`; the eroded pass frees 牙 from a reflection bridge to the poster's white border, the plain pass keeps the small 姜文电影 whose strokes the erosion takes away). A character is a blob at least `SNAP_MIN` 0.15 text heights tall and smaller than the box itself (`SNAP_MAX` 0.95 of its width and height — v298, H's 流浪地球 poster: "Hier hat das framing nicht richtig funktioniert" — the brush title's strokes join into one blob of 344×370 px, a cap at 1.3 text heights dropped it and the frame was made from the small pieces, cutting 流 and 地; a border ring around the box is bigger than the box and still drops). A **clean** blob — whole, not cut by the widened box's edge — counts by its whole extent when at least half of it lies inside the AI's box; **a fused blob counts by its part inside** (v299, 流浪地球 taken again, upright: "Still the same" — the title's blob had fused with something running to the picture's edge, fell out, and the dark gaps inside the title made the box) when that part is a character's size both ways and holds a text height's square of ink (`Hb²` — the wedge of 邪不压正's slanted border inside the box does not); a blob whose inside part covers 0.9 of the box both ways is the background or a ring and drops; a clean blob with no pixel inside stays for the sideways pass; the colour whose characters cover more area is the text (**no median or dominant colour tells the background here — the white title fills more of Qwen's box than the red does**, measured). Then four passes: **sideways** — a clean blob of the text's colour in a taken blob's line band within half a text height joins (sideways only: under a line the cheeks of the faces would qualify); **the column pass** (v303, 绿皮书: the reflection streak, 15–20 px thick on the copy, fused with 书 and ran to the picture's edge, so 书 was no clean blob and held too little ink for the fused rule — the snap ended after 皮) — a fused blob of the text's colour beside a taken blob is read column by column within the line's band (`fused`, `masks`, `SNAP_COL` 0.15): a column with at least 0.15 of the band's height in ink and nothing of the blob further than a quarter of the band above or below it is a stroke's (the white mat beside 邪不压正 runs the whole height — without that rule it joined), the streak's thin columns are not, and the run of stroke columns nearest the line joins by its own extent; **the width budget** (`trim`, v305, H's 业主直租 sign with a QR code beside the text: "Das ginge schon noch zentrierter" — the code's bottom finder square is a dark blob of a character's size in the second line's band, and the snap took it, 22–85 % across where the characters end at 58 %) — the taken blobs are grouped into line bands by vertical overlap, a band whose blobs span more than `SNAP_WIDE` 1.6 × its line's character count (`lens`, the answer's lines without spaces and punctuation; matched to the lines by order when the counts agree, else the longest line for every band — vertical credits split into many bands on a poster) × its tallest blob is cut at gaps of `SNAP_GAP` 0.8 text heights into runs, and the run with the most blob area keeps its neighbours only while the width stays within the budget (a word space is under one text height; the gap to the code was 119 px against a text height of 100); **the shadow pass** (v306, 邪不压正 photographed again with a lamp at its right: "Jetzt funktioniert das schon wieder nicht" — the poster's left half in shadow, and under the one Otsu cut over the box the dark 邪 on that darker ground was no blob at all, nothing to erode or join: the true cause of every 邪 cut since v300, not the mat, as v300's reading from a reconstruction without the shadow had guessed) — from each end of every line, anchored on the tallest taken blob within 5 % of the union's end, a strip of 1.5 text heights beyond the union (the blob's own rows, a tenth of a height of room) is cut by its own Otsu, and a blob of the text's colour of a character's kind — not touching the strip's outer edge, at least 0.3 text heights tall, 0.3–1.3 wide, filled under 0.85, at least 1.6 ink runs per row on average (the wall above the poster is one solid run per row and 0.93 filled) — within half a text height of the line's end and overlapping its band by half joins; up to three per side, then the width budget runs again. The snapped box is the union; nothing, or under a fifth of the AI's box, leaves the AI's box as it is (Diagnostics "the AI's box … snapped to the ink: …", `r.pic.snap`). Measured in the harness: 邪不压正 29–93 % × 29–79 % → 18–84 % × 30–73 % (邪 whole, 姜文电影 and HIDDEN MAN in, the faces out), the lamp photo 25–71 % × 22–57 % (邪 whole), 绿皮书 1–99 % × 17–72 % (书 whole, the streak beyond it out), 业主直租 21–58 % × 26–53 % (the code out), both 流浪地球 cases keep the credits, the title and the film line. **Tried and dropped, all unmerged:** light–dark crossings per row and column (the faces' rows had as many as the title's, the slanted border and the glass reflections kept every column lively); a walk along the line's ink beyond the blobs (took 邪不压正's slanted border and 流浪地球's robot arm for strokes, 6–8 % wider); a second, twice as strong erosion (cut the faces into character-sized pieces the sideways chain walked into); lighting flattening with a local mean over an integral image (rescued 邪 at one window size, invented blobs at 流浪地球's edges at every other); looser threshold passes; a wider search box (`SNAP_ROOM` 2) with a near-margin rule; fused candidates outside the box — each broke an earlier poster. **The limit** (H on v300's cut 邪: "Leave it as it is."): a character the box misses and the pixels fuse with its surroundings stays outside; the frame's corner is the hand's fix. **A character written in bars alone (v376, H's 三立方咖啡 shop sign, 2026-09-09 — the card's picture began at 立: "Here's another wrong crop"):** 三 is three horizontal strokes with air between them, so under the box's cut it is three blobs, each about a twentieth of the text height — every one of them a speck by `SNAP_MIN`, and the snap began at the next character (Qwen's box 13–92 % across, the snap 31–91 %). Now bars of the same colour standing over one another — each `SNAP_BAR` 1.6 times wider than tall, within `SNAP_STACK` half a text height of each other, sharing at least 0.6 of their width, together between `SNAP_MIN` and 1.25 text heights tall and no wider than 1.5 of one — are put together into one character before the colours are weighed (三, 二, 三十 and the like). **One bar alone is not**: a rule under a line, the edge of a plate and an underline stay out. Measured on the sign rebuilt in the harness: the snap 14–75 % across where it was 26–75 %, so 三 is whole. Suite `verify-aiframe` (`bars`: the rebuilt sign with Qwen's real box — the snap's left edge at or under 20 % and the frame's at or under 18 %); the panel, autocard, picture, badpic and english suites pass. Not yet field-checked — the sign taken again is the check: 三立方咖啡 whole in the card's picture. **A plate is not the text (v315, H's parking sign 请您停车入位, 2026-09-07 — the card's picture ran from 11 to 100 % across with the plate ending at 81 %: "Warum ist das nicht mittig?"):** rebuilt in the harness from the card's crop laid into a photo of the ground's colour, with Qwen's real box `[100,430,560,550]` of 600×800: the white plate's part inside the box was 84 % of its width and 78 % of its height — under the background rule's 0.9 both ways — and its area (22 500 px) beat the six dark characters (10 000 px), so the light colour was the text, the plate its one "character", and the shadow pass then joined the light specks of the textured ground beside it (2 runs per row, 0.5 filled — a character's kind by every measure), 16–99 % across; the v313 edge rule fired on top of that. Now, before the colours are weighed, **a blob wider than two text heights that holds a row of two or more character-shaped clean blobs of the other colour** — at least 0.4 text heights tall, no wider than 1.3 times their height, within its width and at least half within its rows, side by side without overlap in one band — is the ground the characters stand on and drops. The row matters: the plain and the eroded pass both see the one character-shaped dark gap inside 流浪地球's brush title, and a first cut of the rule that only counted such blobs took the two sightings for two and dropped the title (the aiframe suite's upright 流浪地球 case fell to 35–96 % across); one gap is no row, and the title keeps its box. Measured: the snap ends on 位, 16–75 % across and 49–63 % down, the frame 10–81 % with the room. And the v313 rule asks whether the proposal's edge is the photo's own before it grows (`seenBase` against the photo, half a percent): on the whole photo there is nothing beyond, and the line no longer claims it. Suite `verify-aiframe` (the rebuilt parking sign with `textRegion`, `textLike` and `effScore` stood down: the snap's line within 13–18 % / 72–78 % across and 46–53 % / 60–66 % down, the frame 7–14 % to 77–85 % across, no edge line); the autoframe, picture and badpic suites pass. Not yet field-checked — the sign taken again is the check: the plate centred in the card's picture with the ground to the right gone. **A character as tall as the AI's box is still a character (v317, H's coconut-water carton 椰子水, 2026-09-07 — the card's crop cut the tops of 椰 and 水: "Warum hat er hier wieder was abgeschnitten??"):** Qwen's box for 椰子水 was 33–59 % down (its coordinates on a 0–1000 grid, which `picBox` scales), the characters 37–62 %, so they stood at 0.95 of the box's height and a little over it — and `SNAP_MAX` 0.95 of the box (v298, for the ring around a box) called every tall stroke of 椰, 子 and 水 "bigger than a character"; a blob that big counts only by its part inside the box with a text height's square of ink, which one character never holds, so the tall strokes fell out, and the short pieces that were left — 木's left stroke, 子's hook, 水's right part — made the box 42–58 % down, 24–81 % across (the log's numbers, read back from the pieces of the photo rebuilt from H's screenshot; a first reading of the log had blamed the crease through 子 and the light windows inside 耳, and a colour rule built on that was dropped unmerged once the pieces matched). Now a blob taller than 0.95 of the box is clean when it is no taller than 1.25 text heights and no wider than 1.5 times its height — a character reaching past a tight box —; a ring around the box is wider than that and still drops, and with two or more lines the text height is under half the box, so nothing changes there. Measured on the rebuilt carton with the box drawn two percent shorter than the characters: the snap 24–80 % across, 38–61 % down (the whole characters), where the same box gave the short pieces before; the parking sign and both 流浪地球 cases unchanged. Suite `verify-aiframe` (the carton with the tight box: the snap's line, the frame's top at or above 35 % and its bottom at or below 63 %); the autoframe, picture, badpic and english suites pass. Not yet field-checked — the carton taken again is the check: 椰子水 whole in the card's picture. **A box that passes the picture's edge by a little is read both ways, and the snap decides (v340, H's ARRI poster 突破光影边界, 2026-09-08 — the card's picture ARRI with the title cut at the bottom: "ARRI gehört nicht rein und chinesischer Text ist abgeschnitten"):** Qwen answered `[120,330,860,450]` for an 800×600 picture — pixels, the title running to the right edge, so x1 passed the width by 60 —, and `picBox` took anything above the picture's size for the 0–1000 grid: 12–86 % across, 33–45 % down is the blank blue above the title, the snap found nothing there, the frame was placed on it and the 16:9 window around it held ARRI and cut the title. The numbers alone cannot tell: the far 邪不压正 of v328 answered the same way and meant the grid (H's other poster of the day, 专业电影人首选, boxed within the picture and came out right — "Hier hat es ja funktioniert"). Now `picBoxPix` gives a second reading when the box passes the picture's width or height by at most `PIX_OVER` 1.2 (and stays under 1000): the numbers as pixels, clamped to the picture (`pic.boxAlt`); in `cropSign`'s box branch both readings are snapped (`snapBox` hands back `count`, the character-shaped blobs it took, both passes together), and **the pixel reading wins when its snap holds at least three such blobs and the grid's fewer** — Diagnostics "the AI's box 12–86 % across, 33–45 % down passes the picture's edge on the 0–1000 grid and holds no characters there — read as pixels it holds 28 blobs of a character's size: 15–100 % across, 55–75 % down", or "… read on the 0–1000 grid it holds 28 blobs of a character's size, read as pixels 2; the grid stays"; the snapped line names the box as read. A box beyond 1.2 × the picture is the grid as before, a box within the picture is pixels as before. What it costs: one more snap on such a box. Tried and dropped on the way: the share of rows that look like text in each box (the glow and the light beam over the blank blue counted as text rows, 66 against 60 %). Rebuilt in the harness from the whole-photo view of H's screenshot (`arri-photo.png`, the whole-photo proposal, Qwen's real answer): the pixel snap 14–92 % across, 48–67 % down — the title —, the frame 10–97 % across, 42–73 % down, ARRI out; the same poster with a grid box on the title that passes the width keeps the grid. Suite `verify-aiframe` (`arri`, `arriGrid`; the far and near 邪不压正 cases unchanged); the autocard, picture, badpic and english suites pass. Not yet field-checked — the ARRI poster taken again is the check: the title in the card's picture, ARRI out. **A word of lines alone is no text, and a cut line gets the whole side (v318, H's Nongfu Spring bottle 农夫山泉, 2026-09-07 — the card showed 泉 with RING under it: "Why is it cut???"):** two faults in one log. The close look read the logo's wave lines as 还一二 at 86 %, and 一二 is in the dictionary, so `textLike` counted two of three characters in dictionary words and the frame was placed on the label's top right corner (79–100 % across, 0–40 % down); the reading stayed weak, the AI got that corner's cut and read 良 from the edge of 泉 with "cut: left,bottom". Now `dictCover(lines,true)` — the strict count `textLike` uses — skips a word of nothing but 一 二 三 十 (lines and stripes read as those); the reader's score keeps the plain count (the strict count went again in v319 with the dictionary path itself). Then the v314 rule grew the frame by 1.2 line heights to the left (68–100 %), the AI read 泉 alone and said "cut: left" again, and the rule runs once — so the card kept 泉. Now the frame reaches **the photo's edge** on every side the AI names as cut: how far the line runs is unknown, the photo's edge is the only sure end, and the AI's box then places the frame on the line; the v312 fine-print rule keeps the small print beside it off the card. What it costs: the second picture is larger (still at most 800 px). Suite `verify-aiframe` (the cut line's grown frame now "8–91 % across, 0–85 % down"; `textLike` on 还一二 at 86 % false, on 坚果供应 true, on 一二三 at 99 % true by the confidence path); the autoframe, picture, twopass and english suites pass. Not yet field-checked — the bottle taken again is the check: 农夫山泉 on the card. **The reader places only from a sure reading, and the AI always sees the whole proposal (v319, H after the bottle: "Is the close look approach the right one at all?" — assessed first, three ways offered, "Go" on the first):** the reader's placement is a fast offline path when the reader is sure, and every failure of the frame since v296 came from a reading the reader was *not* sure of — the faces at 86 %, the wave lines as 还一二 at 86 %, the credits under 邪不压正 as 册 | 二 | 国有证 with the sure characters at 90 % — that a dictionary word inside the garbage (品语, 一二, 国有) waved through; and once such a frame stood, the v301 rule sent the AI only its cut, so the AI could not see the text beside it and only centre the frame inside the garbage (the bottle: 泉 alone, twice). Now **`textLike` is one bar**: at least `PLACE_MIN` three characters read with confidence (`SURE_BOX` 70), at `PLACE_CF` 95 % on average — no dictionary path (v296's, with v318's patch), no two-character line; 90 was tried first and let the credits' 90.25 place the frame in the harness, real text reads at 95–99 in the quick look (绿友书一 97, 手作冰淇淋 97). The close look's placement (`place`, `textBandOf`) uses the same bar. And **the picture the AI gets is always the area the reading started from with its straightening** (`picBase={orig:r.blob,dk}`, `sg.picBlob=dk.blob`) — the proposal, or the hand's frame —, never the placed frame's cut: a reading that ends weak after a sure placement is fragile (绿皮书: the quick look read the title at 97 % on the 1 000 px copy, the reading proper on the whole proposal did not), so the AI decides from the whole proposal — the main text only, without fine print or a line the edge cuts (v312) — and its box places the frame anywhere in it (`frameOnText` through `base`); the v303 centring inside the placed cut only remains after a v314 regrow, where the grown frame is what the AI saw. The v314/v318 regrow grows the frame the AI saw — the proposal — past the named edge, whatever the reader placed meanwhile. What it costs: on 绿皮书's kind of poster the AI's box has to find the title in the whole poster instead of a cut the reader had found (the v312 fine-print rule keeps the Oscar line off the card); a card whose reading ends weak shows the proposal until the AI answers. Considered and not built: the AI first on every photo (option 2) — every framed area would leave the phone, against the rule that photos go out only when the reading is weak, and one more call's latency on every clean sign; leaving it (option 3). Measured in the harness: 邪不压正 places nothing from the reader now and the AI's box places the frame as before (10–93 % across, 19–84 % down, turned by −8°), the synthetic poster's quick look still places (97 %) and the AI's box from the whole proposal lands where the quick look had it, 流浪地球 upright runs the box path on the whole photo as on the phone, the parking sign, the carton, the QR sign, the shadow photo and the cut-line case unchanged in their outcomes. Suite `verify-aiframe` (the whole-proposal line on the synthetic poster and its Save-now case with the box placing the frame near the quick look's, 流浪地球's box path without a reader placement, the cut line grown from the proposal "(0–100 % across, 0–91 % down)", `textLike` on 坚果供应 at 90–93 % false and at 94–97 % true, 坚果 at 99 % false, the credits false); the autoframe, picture, badpic, savenow, twopass and english suites pass. Not yet field-checked — the next poster whose reading ends weak is the check: the frame on the main text, nothing from outside it on the card. **Fine print does not place the frame (v320, H's yoghurt pack 水果多多, 2026-09-08 — the card's picture the whole pack: "Aber jetzt nimmt er wieder so gut wie alles mit rein. Geht das nicht intelligenter?"):** the quick look read the small print under the title — 免豆水果制品和酸奶块口感, 即食添加量30丰富 — at 95 %, real text that passes the v319 bar, and framed the whole photo around it (9–100 % across, 0–100 % down); the title 水果多多 was read only by the close look, at 99 % and 1.5 × the ink height, when the frame was already placed and could not move; the reading was strong, so no AI. The frame's ink height (`inkHeight`, `Hink`) already tells how tall the main text is — the small print measured 0.29 of it, real readings 0.4–2.5 (the `sizeFitOf` range) —, so **`tallLines(lines,Hink)` drops lines under `PLACE_H` 0.4 of it** before the placement: the quick look logs "quick look: … — fine print beside taller ink, left out: … — nothing left to frame" (or "not text" for what is left) and places nothing from them, and the close look's `place` filters every tight pass's lines the same way, so the title's passes alone give `textBandOf` the frame. A line without boxes stays; an ink height of 0 filters nothing. What it costs: a frame whose ink height is inflated by decoration could leave real text under 0.4 unplaced — then the proposal stands, the reading proper runs as before and the card's picture is the tightened band. Measured in the harness: the synthetic pack (the title at 170 px, three lines of small print) with the whole-photo proposal and the quick look made to see only the small print — the two lines left out, nothing framed from them, the close look places the frame on the title (8–90 % across, 26–48 % down), the card 水果多多. Suite `verify-aiframe` (that case, `readPass` stood down for the first call; `tallLines` keeps the tall line and a line without boxes, and everything at an ink height of 0); the autoframe and english suites pass. Not yet field-checked — the pack taken again is the check: the frame on 水果多多. **The reading's winning pass places the frame (v321, H's Nongfu Spring bottle taken again at v320 — the card's picture with the mountain logo above 农夫山泉: "Besser, aber das Bild über der Schrift gehört auch nicht rein"):** the quick look read 1入从全 at 72 % and placed nothing, the reading proper's first pass read garbage too, so the close look's band sat on the logo and its tight passes read 共生生 and the like, the 2 s fallback showed the proposal (4–100 % across, 0–60 % down, the ink rows), and the text 农夫山泉 / 饮用天然水380 was read by the whole-frame fallback's black-and-white pass at 98 %, score 241 — strong, so no AI, and a pass that could not place the frame, since only the close look's tight passes did (`place`). Now, after the competition, **a strong best pass that is not a tight one** (`!best.tightened`, `effScore` at or above `WEAK_READ`) whose lines pass the placement bar (`tallLines`, `textLike`) gives the frame the way the quick look does — `rectOfLines(bmp,lines)`, the quick look's rule factored out: the confident boxes, the line ends from the image, `FRAME_ROOM` — through `placeRect(rect,"reading")`, while the frame is still the app's and untouched (hidden, or proposed and not followed; a Save-now card through `READ_APP[id]` and no `PLACED[id]`); Diagnostics "frame placed on the text by the reading: …"; `frameOnText`'s `by` names it in the log only, the guard is cropSign's. A tight best pass changes nothing (the close look placed from it, or its lines failed the bar). Once placed: `CROP.rect`, `CROP.proposed="text"`, `CROP.followed`, `CROP.hidden` goes, the layer gets `.framed`, the bar reads "Reading the text …" with Save now, Diagnostics "frame placed on the text: 8–91 % across, 65–85 % down" (`frameOnText`; a text that fills the proposal, every edge within 1 %, shows the proposal itself). **The card image is the placed frame's cut** (`cropBlob` with the new rect, `placedCut`; the second look's `cutUnrotated` band only when no frame was placed), the picture the AI gets is that cut, and the card's `frame` is the placed frame — the frame, the enlarged view, the picture and the stored frame are one thing. **It never moves after that**: a later re-read by hand starts a fresh log and never places (`CROP.proposed` goes at the hand's first gesture, `wireCrop`'s pointerdown). **A card saved with Save now gets the placed frame too** (v304, H's three posters on v303 — 流浪地球, 邪不压正, 绿皮书 — every card with the whole frame's crop and the Review flag: "Enger crop funktioniert manchmal, aber nicht immer" — Save now takes the frame away (`CROP=null`), so `frameOnText`'s `PENDING` guard had refused every placement and `finishPending` kept the crop of the frame the card was saved with): `PLACED[id]` = the frame placed while the card waited, only when the reading started from the app's own frame (`READ_APP[id]`, set at `cropSign`'s start from `CROP.hidden`/`proposed`, carried by `saveNow` as `reading.app` and by `resumePending`; the hand's frame stays the card's), a frame already placed at the tap becomes `PLACED` at once (`saveNow`, `CROP.followed`), the AI gets that frame's cut and centres inside it, `finishPending` takes `PLACED[id]` as the card's `frame` and the placed cut as its `img`, and `abandonReading`, `finishPending` and `failPending` drop it; the `frameOnText` guard is one test (`pend`); the Edit form's hand-off (`RECROP` → `PENDING`) carries no `app`, so nothing moves there. The box branch's catch logs `logErr("snap")` and "the AI's box could not be used: …" instead of swallowing the error.

**While the app looks:** a stroke frames by hand (`hiddenTake` in `wireCrop`: from 8 px of movement the search and its reading stop — `abandonReading` —, the frame is drawn from the press point and read as any hand frame; a tap changes nothing, the search goes on; the click handler and the enlarged view ignore a hidden frame; the layer carries no `.framed` while hidden, so the stroke draws instead of scrolling). The Edit form's Crop again keeps the shown proposal with its preview and wait (`RECROP`), a Save-now card has no frame left (`PENDING`), a turned frame is the hand's. **The frame's dashes travel along its edge while the reading and the AI work on it** (v295; H: "show swirls of color in the image while analyzing the frame area (or propose something better!!!)", then on the blobs: "I'm not sure if I'm happy with the swirls. I just want the user to know that something's happening with the crop frame"): while `READING[id]` holds a step that is no failure, the frame carries `.working` and a `.work` overlay with an SVG rectangle on its edge (`inset:-2px`, the rect 1 px inside, stroke #fff 2 px, `stroke-dasharray 7 5`, `march` .8 s linear; the static dashed border transparent meanwhile, the dark outline and the handles stay, nothing on the picture, no touches taken; still under `prefers-reduced-motion`); in the inbox and Crop again alike, gone with the editor; nothing while the frame is still hidden. **Rejected on the way, do not bring back unasked:** the sweeping tint band over the photo of v288–v290 (H had asked for it as "some apps show a wafting color over the image while it's analyzed by AI", and once the quick look placed the frame within a second: "If it's so fast, then we don't need the wafting color, right?"; `.shotwrap .scan`, `--tint-scan` and `@keyframes scan` left styles.css) and the two blurred blobs of the tint and a warm gold drifting inside the frame of v294 (the swirls). **Also found on the way (v290):** the reading status writes the bar straight into the photo's box (`readingStatus`), and the traditional reader's chain that runs on in the background when the copies made the reading strong (v236) once kept sending "recognizing … N %" after the editor was up — a finished reading bumps its run (`done(r)` at every exit of `cropSign`) and the chain checks `r.done` between passes and stops; and **the reader is warmed when the Camera tab opens** (`warmReader` in `renderInbox`, once per session, only when all `OCR_FILES` are on the phone), so the first photo does not pay the reader's load. The guide's first paragraph describes it ("The app looks for the text and draws a frame around it while it reads … Let go, and the reading starts again.", six languages).

**Measured in the four-core sandbox,** from the photo landing to the frame: the synthetic poster (drawings above 手作冰淇淋) 0.3 s, the red 有 0.1 s, H's five-line poster 0.9 s (1.4 s as the session's first photo, with the reader's load); the editor follows at 2.6–4.8 s; the phone's eight cores are not measured, and the 2 s fallback stays for a slow phone. The frames: the synthetic poster 8–91 % across, 65–85 % down (手作冰淇淋 across the whole thumbnail, screenshot `autoframe-list`), the red 有 the ink-row proposal, H's five-line poster a trim of 2 %; the proposal on H's street photo of the two-line sign takes the fence below it (the fence bars look like text rows) and the reader's placement tightens; nothing to fix on the ten regression images, which are tight crops and get the whole photo. **Field-confirmed:** the frame on the 流浪地球 title (v299/v300, H: "Wondering earth works now") and the quick look's frame on the 绿皮书 title block (v301, H: "you did really well by identifying the main characters in the image. And cropping around them"). **Not yet field-checked:** the marching dashes (v295), the centred frame (v303), Save now with the placed frame (v304), the 业主直租 sign without its code (v305), the shadow pass on the lamp photo (v306), the slow reading's move (v310), the upright frame on 无名 (v311), the main text only on 青春无烟 (v312), the frame reaching beyond the proposal on the 北京现代 badge (v313), the cut line read again on 大闸蟹 (v314), the plate dropped by the snap on the parking sign (v315), the tall characters kept on the coconut carton (v317), the wave logo no longer text and the cut line's side on the Nongfu bottle (v318), the one bar for the reader's placement and the whole proposal to the AI (v319), fine print left out of the placement (v320), the winning pass placing the frame (v321), the reader's boxes trimmed by the snap (v322), a line the AI's box left out read by the reader and joined (v324), and how long the search takes on the Xiaomi. **Suites:** `verify-autoframe` (H's poster: the search state — hidden proposal "whole", no `.framed`, "Finding the text …", no Save now, the log's "(not shown)" —, then the frame shown as proposed with `.framed`, Save now and "Reading the text …", the five lines read, Cancel and Crop without a proposal; the synthetic poster: the hidden proposal over drawings and text, the frame placed on the text with `followed`, the rect unchanged through the editor, the picture the frame's cut to the pixel, no re-read after 1.8 s, Save storing that frame and picture; the red 有's proposal, a corner dragged by hand staying where the hand put it and reading 有; a tap during the search changes nothing, a stroke takes over with the hand's frame; `FRAME_WAIT` at 0.3 s: the proposal shown after 0.5 s, then placed with `followed` (v310); the working frame's dashes, the transparent border, the overlay taking no touches, gone with the editor), `verify-aiframe` (H's 邪不压正 poster with Qwen's real pixel answer: the box path from the proposal, the snap within 15–20 % / 82–87 % across and 27–32 % / 70–75 % down, the frame at −8° reaching under 12 % and past 90 % across, the three log lines, Save with `frame.a` −8; H's 流浪地球 poster from his screenshot and the upright photo with Qwen's real answers; 绿皮书 with the real box [30,20,680,250] of 800×284; the placed-cut cases with `effScore` at 0 — the frame placed by the quick look, the picture as wide as the placed cut, the centred line with the frame inside the placed one; 业主直租 with the code and `textLike` stood down; the lamp photo of 邪不压正 (the snap's left edge under 30 %, the frame's left under 26 %); Save now on the placed frame and on the shown proposal; the 无名 photo upright inside the photo from 20 % down; a three-line answer with line boxes whose small lines are dropped; `picBox` on fractions, pixels, the grid and junk; a frame drawn by hand during the search never moved), and the twopass, consensus, picture, badpic, frameadjust, recrop, savenow, diag, english and guide suites alongside; the search phase and the placed frame checked by screenshot in light and dark.  Otherwise, or after Cancel: a finger stroke draws a rectangle (bright dashed frame with a dark outline, nothing dimmed), the corner handles resize it, dragging inside moves it, a preview of the cut sits below. **Reading starts by itself 1.2 s after the finger lifts** (`READ_TIMER`; a corner drag restarts the wait; "Read now" and a small "Image only" link remain). **The frame can be turned** (v185, H: "enable rotating the crop rectangle", described first and built on "Go"): a round handle with a stem hangs 34 px above the frame's top edge (`.h.rot`, `ROT_HANDLE`); dragging it turns the frame around its centre (`CROP.rect.a` in degrees, the raw pointer, not the clamped one, so the finger may leave the photo; snapped to 0 within 1.5°), the frame is drawn with `transform:rotate(a)` and the corner and inside tests run in the frame's own turned coordinates (`rotPt`, `toLocal`; a corner drag in the old centre's turned system is shifted so the rect turned around its new centre lands on the same spot), moving keeps the angle, a new frame starts at 0°. `cropBlob` draws the photo turned back around the frame's centre, so the cut is the frame's content **upright** — the reader's straightening then finds nothing to do (`sg.angle` 0), the card image is the upright cut, and what the frame covers outside the photo takes the dominant colour of the real pixels around it (`dominantRGB`, shared with `deskewBlob` since v185; probing the canvas outside the photo once made that colour black and the reader read garbage); the enlarged view of a turned frame shows the upright cut itself (`_prevURL`). Measured on the 12° test sign: a frame turned to −13° cuts an upright image (deskew 0) that reads both lines at once. It stays a rectangle — not the four free corners of v127/v128. **The browser's own touch behaviours stay off the app** (v248–v249; H's screenshot while adjusting a frame in Crop again: Chrome's "Copy image / Download image / Share image" sheet over the frame — "Don't make those things pop up while adjusting the crop", then "Find all such useless behaviours and remove them"): one `contextmenu` listener on the document cancels the long-press menu on every picture, canvas and control (`img, canvas, button, .croplayer, .shotwrap, .drawsheet, .picbox, .thumbbox, .reticle, .ck, .chip, .tab, .grade, .seg, .linked`), and styles.css gives pictures and canvases `-webkit-touch-callout:none`, `-webkit-user-drag:none` and `user-select:none`, the controls (buttons, tabs, chips, grade tiles, strips, the picker, the switch, the drawing sheet, the crop layer, the text box, the photo boxes, the enlarged view, the linked row) `user-select:none`, and `body` `touch-action:manipulation` — no double-tap zoom, the crop layer and the pad keep their stricter values (the callout is Safari's, for the iPhone). **The badges and the forms' labels are non-selectable too since v272** (`.badge`, `label`, `.topline`, `.mrow .t` in the same rule — H's screenshot: a long press on the Edit badge had opened the Xiaomi's dictionary card for "edit" under the form); plain text — More's sentences, the fields, the meaning — keeps its menu, so a meaning can still be copied (measured: `user-select` none on the badge, the label and the hint, auto on the meaning field and More's sentence). **The keyboard's autocorrect, capitalisation and spell-check are off** on the fields that hold Chinese, pinyin or a search — the Add and Edit forms' characters and pinyin, the context word and its pinyin, the line inputs under the strips, the preview's pinyin and the Cards search (`autocorrect="off" autocapitalize="off" spellcheck="false"`; Android capitalised the first letter of a pinyin textarea and underlined every syllable) — the meaning fields keep them, English prose wants them. Measured in Chromium: the contextmenu event is cancelled on the front picture and text box, a tab, a grade tile, a list thumbnail, a chip, the Edit form's crop, a strip character, the pad, the reference view and the sheet, and not on the meaning field; the attributes sit on the pinyin, line and search fields; the phone's long press not yet field-checked. **A changed frame drops the old reading at once** (v286, H's SF Express card, 2026-09-07: "Crop and recrop didn't work as expected … It doesn't crop to my selection" — the card carried the whole panel and both lines under a frame pulled onto 顺丰速运 alone): until v285 a corner drag or a move only restarted the 1.2 s wait, and the old reading stayed in `SIGN[id]`; any re-render in that window — on the phone the first reading's AI answer landing after the drag — drew the old editor with its Save card again, and Save stored the old picture and text with the new frame. Now the frame's release calls `abandonReading(id)` (the timer, the run number, the reading and its status go; a running reading abandons at its next step, the old AI answer finds no reading) before the preview and the re-read. Suite `verify-frameadjust` (the two-line sign read whole, the top corner pulled onto the second line: A — the re-read gives one line and Save stores it with the new frame and a low crop; B — a re-render during the wait shows no Save card; C — the drag during the first reading's AI check, its late answer changes nothing, the re-read's own answer fills the card); the lock, zoom, rotate, recrop, savenow, autoframe, touchcrop and english suites pass. Not yet field-checked. **Once a frame exists it is the only frame** (H, v129–v132, seen on the phone): a stroke outside it draws nothing and **scrolls the page** like anywhere else (the layer carries `.framed` with `touch-action:pan-y` from the finger's release and whenever `CROP.rect` is set in the render; the frame and its handles keep `touch-action:none` and take the finger), adjusting the frame is allowed at any time, during a reading too, and re-reads; a new frame needs **Cancel** first, which removes the frame and stops a running reading. **A tap outside the frame enlarges the framed area** (v169, H: "toggle between full image display and only cropped area display by tipping with a finger outside the cropped area", described first and built on "Go"): a short tap without movement (under 8 px and 600 ms; a swipe still scrolls) sets `CROP.zoom` — **the tap is taken from the click event** (v206, H: "tipping outside a cropped frame and then reducing the visible image to the cropped part does not seem to work with iPhone": until v205 it was read from `pointerup` with the distance and time check, and on a layer that lets the page scroll (`touch-action:pan-y`) iOS Safari turns the touch into a scroll gesture and sends `pointercancel`, so no pointerup ever came; a click is the platform's own "a tap, not a scroll" on every browser — the press position and time are kept for the same check, so a mouse drag outside the frame, which also ends in a click, does not toggle, and a frame gesture marks the layer (`layer._gesture`) so its closing click is ignored; measured in Chromium with mouse and with emulated touch, the iPhone itself not yet — no WebKit in the sandbox), the photo box then shows the cut alone with a 4 % margin, enlarged to the box's width (`.shotzoom`, a background image positioned by percentages, `zoomStyle`), the frame's handles hidden; a tap on the enlarged view goes back, the frame is where it was; adjusting the frame stays in the whole-photo view; Cancel clears it with the frame (`CROP=null`). **Each reading has a run number** (`READ_RUN[id]`): a reading that a corner drag or Cancel superseded abandons at its next step — no status text, no result, no AI call (v117: two readings of one frame once asked DeepSeek twice within a second). **The frame stays on the photo** through reading and the card preview (`cropRectStyle` re-draws it from `CROP.rect` in percentages after any re-render) and goes only on Save or Cancel. No dialogs in the flow: no frame → nothing happens; the same text from the same photo is an inline note ("This text is already saved from this photo.", `d.c===c&&d.shot===id`), from another photo it becomes a second card (v118).
3. **Read** (`cropSign`): the framed area is **straightened first** (`deskewBlob`: projection-profile skew estimate on a ≤ 360 px copy, ±20° in 1° steps then half degrees, text pixels = far from the median brightness so both polarities count; below 1.5° nothing happens; **the rotated copy is for the reader only — the card image is the crop as framed, never rotated** (v145, H: "don't show the cropped images rotated in the preview, I don't want to see that gray frame around them"); the corners the rotation opens in the reading copy are filled with the crop's dominant colour — the most frequent 4-bit colour bin, then the mean of its pixels (v138, H's 美团 logo: one edge pixel was the dark logo frame, the dark corners became the "ink" of the chromaticity copy, the black characters fell on its background side, the ink height came out as 0 and the reader never saw 美团 at a fitting size; a channel-wise median is no real colour and a border colour is the frame line again — both changed the ink height of 业主直租 and lost its winning pass); H: a tilted 首都铁骑 read as garbage) → on-device OCR line by line (Tesseract.js 7, `chi_sim`, PSM 6, symbols under confidence 35 dropped; `readPass`; **digits are kept** when fairly sure (confidence ≥ 70) and near the characters' height (0.4–1.6 × the line's median box height — the boxes' heights swing: a ribbon ring once read as a 1 at 2.1 ×, the real 30 of 30分钟 measured 0.55–0.7 ×; H: the number was missing from the translation); letters stay out; a number reads as itself in `lineMeaning` and stays one token in the pinyin, `pySpaced`) — the status text lives in `READING[id]` and is re-queried on every update, so a re-render (foreground return, AI answer for another photo) cannot swallow it or the error; the user sees **one line with a moving bar** (`readingHTML`: "Reading the text …") for every step, only failures show as text (H: the steps are of no use to the user); a step that lasts longer than `READ_STUCK` (20 s) shows its own text under the bar ("still at: loading the reader …", `READ_AT`), because a stuck step is a failure; `cropSign` is guarded from its first line (the cut-out, the reader load) and every failure shows as "Reading failed: …" and goes to the error log — → second look (`secondLook`) and competing readings (below) → `SIGN[id]` = `{lines, orig, conf, boxes, img, angle, tightened, region, alts}` (`img` = the straightened, maybe tightened crop the text was read from, `boxes[k][i]` = each symbol's box in it; `region.passes` = the competition and `region.tightBlob` the tight crop, for diagnosis; **`alts`** (v96) = up to six other readings, distinct texts best first, always including the traditional reader's best and the best reading of another length — the AI gets them as `alt` ("the true text is often a mix of them, or a well-known name they circle around"; 养兴多 / 义乐多 / 和准浴多 → 养乐多), the picker offers their characters at the same position (`altCharsAt`, lines with the same character count only), and they are saved on the card as `alts` for a later AI check) → the editor, laid out **like the Edit form** (H, v90): a **Characters** field (H, v114 — not "Text"; the Edit form and the Add form say the same instead of "Word" / "Sign text") with a **character strip** per line (and a **line input under the strip** for typing the correct text (v120, H: "like in Edit mode" — it went in v109 as "unnötig" and came back for the 拉 door plate that no reading got right; on `change` the strip is redrawn from the typed line and the AI check runs again, `wireSlines(root,onInput,onCommit)`; the Edit form has the same input, and its strip follows typing the same way since v120)), a Pinyin field and a Meaning field that follow the reading and the AI check unless edited by hand (`sg.pinTouched`/`meanTouched`, set by the fields' input handlers in `wireSlines` — a hand-written meaning saves as verified, no offline model), a **⚑ Flag for review** checkbox with a note field (`sg.flag`/`flagNote`, `data-sflag`/`data-snote` — H, v94: flag a new card at once instead of opening it again; the Add form has the same pair, `f-flag`/`f-note`, kept in the draft), the source under the meaning ("from the phrasebook" / "composed word by word, unverified"; after a good AI answer nothing — **never "checked by the AI"**, H v105: "not relevant for user", and since v154 not the model's remark either, H: "don't show the OCR slip message to the user";
